QUOTE: "**"Not indexed symbol with this name"** — high, but only inside the stated scope... **"Repository does not contain it"** — low to medium."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer distinguishes in-scope definitive empties from out-of-scope ones, but never names the "definitive for a reason that is not absence" grade (an empty reply that is definitive because of something other than absence), nor a distinct "not definitive" grade as a reply-level classification.
